entities.summary: Julius Fromm was a Polish-German chemist and entrepreneur who invented the seamless rubber condom. Owing to his Jewish heritage, his company and personal property was stolen by the Nazis in aryanization when he left Germany for England in 1939. His legacy was not easily reclaimed by his relatives after the war however.
